services.desc: In Norse mythology, ”Mjölnir“ (pronounced “me-OL-near” - the “j” is silent) is the hammer of the Thunder God, Thor, and the symbol of his power. This is appropriate, considering her owner/operator is captain Thorin (Thor) Lindstrom, founder of Lahaina Maritime. Departing from south Maui’s Ma’alaea Harbor, the 37′ Viking Valhalla, Mjölnir operates private, 4-hour bottom fishing charters, as well as sport fishing charters, whale watching, and sunset cruises. This brand new, custom-made center console vessel is the ideal choice for anglers age 10 and up. She accommodated up to 6 guests.
